run_qps_scenario_check: run the check_qps_scenario_changes script to verify qps benchmark scenarios are up to date
run_scenario_generators: run the json_run_localhost and qps_json_driver scenario generator scripts via subprocess
check_git_status_for_bzl: check git status porcelain output for uncommitted changes to qps scenario bzl files
run_ci_sanity_check: run the sanity check script that validates qps benchmark scenario files are committed
review_scenario_gen_workflow: review the script that generates qps scenarios and checks for uncommitted bzl file changes
